title.zh: 实数与数轴 · √2 落在哪一点
title.en: Real Numbers & the Number Line · Where √2 Lands

description.zh: 单位正方形的对角线给出 √2 在数轴上的位置；它不能写成分数，小数不结束不循环，但可二分逼近。小数位由精确整数运算得到。
description.en: The unit square's diagonal places √2 on the number line; it is not a fraction, its decimals neither stop nor repeat, yet bisection closes in on it. Digits come from exact integer arithmetic.

reason.zh: 单位圆上的角度和坐标（如 √2/2）都是实数；先知道无理数在数轴上有确切位置，才好理解它们。
reason.en: Angles and coordinates on the unit circle (such as √2/2) are real numbers; knowing irrational numbers have exact places on the line makes them easier to accept.

title.en: Where exactly is √2 on the number line?

ask.zh: 单位正方形的对角线有多长？这条线段能放到数轴上吗？
ask.en: How long is a unit square's diagonal? Can that length be placed on the number line?

ask.zh: √2 不能写成分数，小数不结束不循环——二分逼近是怎样一点点夹住它的？
ask.en: √2 is not a fraction and its decimals neither stop nor repeat — how does bisection close in on it step by step?

reveal.zh: 对角线长 √2，它在数轴上有确定的位置；不能写成分数，但可用二分法无限逼近，夹在两个越来越近的有理数之间。
reveal.en: The diagonal is √2 long and has an exact place on the number line; it is no fraction, but bisection traps it between rational numbers that draw ever closer.
